## Responsibility

`HostGenerator` for Claude Code: writes `.claude/agents/<id>.md` from canonical agents (ADR-0030). `ClaudeAgentHost` runs a canonical agent through the Claude Agent SDK for `run drive`; questions and permission prompts go to a person (ADR-0051).

## Invariants

- Without general Bash, each `metator` group is allowed on its own [[cite: packages/plugin-host-claude/src/claude-generator.ts:77 | "for (const g of metatorGroups(agent)) tools.add(`Bash(${context.metatorCommand} ${g}:*)`);"]].
- Claude Code tool names and model aliases live in one table each, pinned by a snapshot test.

## Allowed dependencies

`@metator/core` and `yaml` only.

## Pitfalls

- `tools` is a comma-separated string in Claude Code, not a YAML list.
- Subagents in Claude Code cannot start other subagents; a coordinator works best as the main agent (`claude --agent`).
